items.summary: Legal disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, public data display, affiliate, advertising, or notification expansion. Woot evidence confirms API access but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public use. Keep the service private and leave rights outreach unsent. Human counsel is required before any upstream permission request, public display, affiliate, advertising, or notification expansion. Ordinary reversible work may continue only if it adds no data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Source-rights evidence is documented but blocked; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; logs, vendor, and incident evidence remain open. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering repository/config data flow and retention, deployed consent behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log fields and access controls, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/request procedures. Do not change production or enable tracking.

Retain the security gate as evidence_needed. No fleet-doctor, operations, authentication, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, TLS, monitoring, incident, or disclosure clearance is evidenced. Continue the existing read-only control matrix without duplicate telemetry, credential access, configuration changes, deployment, or external outreach.

Measurement and monetization remain conditional or blocked. Amazon evidence is $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21 and cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. Preserve aggregate rows separately and require registered tracking IDs for future affiliate links.
